subject: Renewal re-engage: term proposal, capacity uplift window & QBR scheduling
messages:
From: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>
To: Tom Li <tom.li@helixworks.ai>, Elena Park <elena@helixworks.ai>, procurement@helixworks.ai
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-11-15T10:12:00-08:00
Subject: Renewal re-engage: term proposal, capacity uplift window & QBR scheduling

Hi Tom / Elena / Procurement team —

Quick re-introduction as we start the renewal window for HelixWorks (deal HLX-2028-042). We’ve scoped a few options that balance unit economics with headroom for seasonal burst. Attached is a short proposal (HLX-term-proposal-v2.pdf) with three commercial options: 12-month base commit + 25% burst, 24-month discounted commit with rolling burst, and a 36-month staircase with tiered pricing.

What I’m hoping we can align on this week:
- Confirm preferred commercial option (12/24/36)
- Target start date for the next term (we have availability Dec 1 or Jan 1)
- QBR scheduling — a 30-min operational + 30-min exec readout is typical; please share availability for week of Nov 27 or Dec 4. I’ve attached a simple calendar poll (QBR-availability-poll.ics).
- Procurement timeline and any legal contacts we should loop in for a quick redline pass.

Operational notes from our side: if you select the 24- or 36-month options we can reserve an extra 2x GPU headroom for the first 90 days to avoid throttling during holiday traffic. Karthik is cc’d and can jump in on sizing if helpful. Ben will own the commercial approval flow.

Next steps: please reply with (1) preferred commercial option, (2) QBR slot preference, and (3) primary procurement contact. If you prefer a quick 15-min sync first, we can do that too.

Thanks — looking forward to getting this scheduled so we can lock capacity ahead of your seasonality.

—
Rachel Kim
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
rachel.kim@redwood.com | (415) 555-0132

Attachments: HLX-term-proposal-v2.pdf (proposal, 2 pages), QBR-availability-poll.ics (calendar poll, 3 options)

From: Tom Li <tom.li@helixworks.ai>

Date: 2028-11-16T09:03:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Renewal re-engage: term proposal, capacity uplift window & QBR scheduling

Thanks Rachel — appreciate the concise options. High level response here: we are definitely interested in an uplift; our traffic is trending +40% month-over-month into December and we need headroom. Two quick questions before we lock a slot:

1) For the 24-month option, what’s the effective per-token price at the 90-day reserved headroom vs. steady-state? We need a number we can take to Finance.
2) If we want a Dec 1 start, what’s the absolute latest we need final signatures by (legal procurement asks)?

QBR availability: Nov 28 between 10–11am PT or Dec 1 between 2–3pm PT work for our Ops + Eng leads. If neither works, we can nominate Dec 5 in the morning.

Looping in procurement (procurement@helixworks.ai) and Elena who is owning renewals on our side. Also please include any redline-ready doc links so our legal can start a quick pass.

Thanks Tom — great questions. Short answers below and I’ve attached a redline-friendly version of the term proposal (HLX-term-proposal-v2.pdf) with per-unit math called out.

1) 24-month option pricing (effective):
   - Reserved headroom (first 90d): $0.0085 / token (estimated, depends on actual burst utilization)
   - Steady-state after headroom: $0.0112 / token
   - We included a sample 30-day forecast in the proposal showing break-even at ~12M tokens/month.

2) For a Dec 1 start we’d need finalized signatures by Nov 30 EOD to hit operational provisioning timelines and to ensure the reserved GPU headroom is provisioned. If you need an interim provisioning waiver we can temporarily extend Dec 1 testing access while legal finishes redlines, but reserved headroom requires contract in place.

Proposed QBR slots (30 min ops + 30 min exec):
  - Option A: Tue Nov 28 10:00–11:00 PT (Ops + Exec)
  - Option B: Fri Dec 1 14:00–15:00 PT (Ops + Exec)
  - Option C: Tue Dec 5 09:00–10:00 PT (Ops only)

Next steps / owners:
  - HelixWorks: confirm preferred commercial option and primary procurement contact (Tom/Elena) — action: reply by Nov 18
  - Redwood (Rachel): prepare final redline doc and commercial summary — action: deliver by Nov 18 (attached)
  - Redwood (Ben): prepare final approval for proposed concession (if any) — action: internal by Nov 22
  - Redwood (Laura): legal to review and note any standard CLA exceptions — action: start review (cc’d)

If you’d like, we can run a very short 15-min pricing walkthrough with Finance before the QBR — Ben can join.

—
Rachel Kim
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
rachel.kim@redwood.com

Laura — looping you in to start legal review; copying ops to keep visibility. Key asks for legal:
- Confirm firewall/data handling language for the 24-mo commit (we use KMS + SOC2 controls; template section 5.2).
- Review the accelerated provisioning clause for the 90-day headroom (we need a clear start/stop definition).
- If Helix wants Dec 1 start with signatures on Nov 30, we need a 24-hour SLA for internal signoff on any minor redline items to meet provisioning cutover.

Rachel / Karthik — I’ll prepare a short commercial summary for Finance showing effective pricing across the three options; will share by Nov 22. Tom / Elena — please confirm which QBR slot you prefer from the options Rachel suggested so we can lock calendars.

Thanks —
